title: AI Labs Should Make Safe Tech Without Antitrust Help, David Sacks Says
description: Top artificial intelligence companies Anthropic PBC and OpenAI should make safe products — and pace their own progress if necessary — without government intervention, David Sacks, co-chair of the President’s Council of Advisors on Science & Technology, said Monday in an interview with Bloomberg TV.

title: DOJ Says Millions in Iranian Oil Proceeds Laundered on Binance
description: The US Justice Department is seeking forfeiture of $61 million it says was generated from Iranian black-market oil sales and laundered through the cryptocurrency exchange Binance.

title: Authentic Brands’ Matt Maddox: Ready to IPO Early 2027
description: Matt Maddox, CEO of Authentic Brands, discusses why the company is partnering with creator Stephen Bartlett in a joint venture rather than pursuing a buyout-style deal. Maddox says Authentic Brands sees the creator economy as a major growth engine for media and audience expansion over the next decade, and views Bartlett as a strong partner for building brands through creator-led platforms. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
